dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you run me through your background again?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: I'm Liben, and once upon a time, I sold curios.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: I'm working hard these days to save up for a nice long vacation.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of business are you talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Simple. You find me a few basic everyday items, cooking ingredients and the like, and then you trade them with me for a Box o' Marvels, full of all kinds of nice little treasures.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Keep in mind that I've filled these Boxes o' Marvels with the fortune I made in my time as a seller of curios. There's no booby prizes to be found here, and I treat all my customers the same.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Why box them up and turn it into a lucky draw, you ask?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: What can I say, people like a gift box. It just makes everyone a little more inclined to get involved.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you earn any money like this?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: They say that everyone in Snezhnaya is tightening their belts, so there should be a business opportunity there or two.
